intent: Submit the related invoices as a single aggregate case so the required aggregate review and higher approval can be obtained before payment.
payload_summary: Create one payment request for the same vendor/business purpose covering three related invoices (9000 + 9000 + 9000 = 27000). Explicitly indicate the items are related and that aggregate approval/review is not yet recorded, prompting the appropriate higher-approval workflow.
preconditions_claimed: Three invoices are related (same vendor, same business purpose, same time window).
Aggregate approval/review and higher approval are not currently recorded.
No valid exception authority is present.
expected_effect: Accountant receives a single aggregate submission that preserves the aggregate context, enabling routing for aggregate review and higher approval rather than processing as separate below-threshold items.
